Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Ljubljana hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 18 Ljubljana hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Hotels.com at 2, Super.com at 2, Vio.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Barcelo.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, Evendo at 1, Reserving at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them. Taxes and fees at Ljubljana hotels

At the 16 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($19 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Grand Hotel Union Eurostars to 20% at Garni Hotel Cirman. At 1 hotel the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 1 hotel no site reported a before-tax price, so its price is a listed price that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
